idea-plugin.name: Agent Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
AI coding agent for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Chat with a language-agnostic agent core (Python) over a local RPC channel: streaming answers, tool execution, memory, skills. The classic work-report generator is being migrated into a built-in skill.
AI 编码助手：通过本地 RPC 通道与语言无关的 Agent Core（Python）对话，支持流式输出、工具执行、 记忆与 Skill。经典的工作报告生成器将迁移为内置 Skill。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.3.1

  • Maintenance build of 3.3.0: same feature set, republished under a new version number so the Marketplace entry can carry the current build. No functional changes.

中文说明：3.3.0 的维护构建，功能与 3.3.0 完全一致，仅递增版本号以便在 Marketplace 上重新发布。

3.3.0

  • Agent teams (off by default): pick a team in the composer and a lead agent dispatches members to research, implement, test and review. Teams are just role references plus capability grants, so one role can be read-only in one team and write-enabled in another.
  • Capabilities: readonly / write / command apply only to members of an enabled team; ad-hoc subagents stay read-only and delete_file is never granted.
  • Pre-review checkpoint: before an implementation phase the team asks once with the plan, the touched files and the first diff. Allowing it makes this phase's routine writes automatic; deletes and dangerous commands still stop for an answer.
  • Team blackboard: research, plans, implementations, tests and reviews are posted as artifacts, shown inline in the timeline and reopenable from the「Artifacts」button.
  • Protocol (additive): team/list, team/artifacts, chat/artifact, agent/confirm with kind="preapprove", and actor/capability on chat/subagent events.
  • Settings page rebuilt as rounded cards (models, agent limits, editor, git, MCP, command allow-list, core runtime). Models are a list plus a form with a provider combo, a masked API key field and a "current model" picker; the MCP box validates JSON as you type.
  • Composer: send and stop share one button, the toolbar is split into attachment / model-team / auto groups, and the status line timer ticks while a task runs.
  • Smoother streaming: core events are marshalled onto the EDT, tokens are batched into one invoke per flush window, auto-grow height is debounced and scroll requests are coalesced.
  • The model's thinking is shown now: reasoning streams (reasoning_content / thinking) used to be dropped by the core. They arrive on a new chat/reasoning notification and fold into one row above the answer ("Thinking · 12.4s · 3,204 chars"); expanding it still shows the whole text — folding only hides, never trims.
  • Tool timeline speaks English: read_file · src/main/App.java · done · 0.4s, agent 全栈工程师[write] · start, mcp server · tool · approval required, queued · waiting for session 2. Step groups report 3 steps · running|done|failed from structured flags instead of sniffing Chinese keywords, so parallel calls keep the group running until the last one returns.
  • Fixed the team switch: on a cold IDE the roster had not been read yet, so the button was greyed out and the first click did nothing (and it never recovered until the tool window was reopened). The button is now always clickable, loads the roster on demand and refreshes once the Core reports ready.

中文说明：新增可开关的 Agent 团队（默认关闭）——在输入区选择团队后由项目经理派发成员调研/ 实现/验证/审查；团队只是角色引用加能力授权，同一角色可在不同团队里获得不同能力。实现阶段前给一次 预审卡（计划 + 涉及文件 + 首个 diff），通过后本阶段写入自动执行，删除与危险命令仍需确认； 研究/计划/实现/测试/审查写入团队黑板，时间线可见并在「交付物」里回看。设置页重做为圆角卡片分节， 模型改为「列表 + 表单」并新增类型下拉、密码框与「当前模型」选择；输入区发送与停止合一，工具栏分组； 流式 token 合批投递、事件统一到 EDT，长文本输入与高速流式不再卡顿。 模型的思考过程（reasoning_content / thinking）此前被 Core 整段丢弃， 现在走 chat/reasoning 通道，折成正文上方一行（思考期间展开、正文开始后收起，点开仍是全文）； 工具与子代理时间线改为英文日志风格（工具名 · 参数 · 结果 · 耗时），步骤组按结构化状态显示 running / done / failed，并行调用不会被先返回的工具提前标为完成。 修复团队开关：冷启动时名册还没读到，按钮被置灰，首次点击没有任何反应，且只有重开工具窗口才会恢复； 现在按钮始终可点，点击时按需启动 Core 并拉取名册，Core 就绪后自动刷新一次。

3.1.2

  • Fixed the missing "new session" and settings buttons in the tab strip: both icons shipped without their SVG resources, so they silently rendered as empty (blank but clickable) icons.
  • Icon loading now logs a warning instead of degrading silently, and a unit test checks that every icon the panel asks for ships with its dark variant.

中文说明：修复标签条上「新建会话」（+）与「设置」按钮不显示的问题——两个图标的 SVG 没有随包 提供，运行期静默退化成空图标；现在加载失败会写日志，并新增单测校验图标资源齐全。

3.1.1

  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (build 263.*): compiled against the 2026.3 platform and the Kotlin 2.4 runtime it bundles.
  • Install range is now 2025.2 - 2026.3; no feature changes.

中文说明：适配 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3（构建号 263.*）——按 2026.3 平台与其内置的 Kotlin 2.4 运行时重新编译，安装区间放宽到 2025.2 ~ 2026.3；功能无变化。

3.1.0

  • New conversation renderer: Markdown is parsed into blocks and painted natively instead of going through an HTML editor pane. Streaming only re-parses the tail block, so long answers (code blocks, tables, lists) no longer stutter or jump the scrollbar.
  • Redesigned panel: tab strip with selection indicator and breathing dot for running sessions, status line moved right above the input, floating composer card with focus ring, drawn attachment chips, empty state with suggestion cards, redrawn checklist with vector marks.
  • One list popup for history and memory: search on top, hover actions, arrow/Enter/Esc navigation; duplicate-memory hints are shown inline instead of in a dialog.
  • MCP tool calls are confirmed by an in-place card (Enter allows, Esc denies) instead of a modal dialog; the dialog is kept as a fallback when the panel is not on screen.
  • Light / dark / high-contrast themes follow the IDE; every colour is resolved at paint time.
  • The agent can now ask before it guesses: a new ask_user tool pauses the turn and shows a question card (single/multi choice plus a free-form answer, Enter to submit, Esc to skip) in the transcript; skipped or unattended questions fall back to stated assumptions.
  • Escape hatch: -Dagent.ui.classic=true brings back the 3.0 HTML transcript.

中文说明：全新的对话渲染（Markdown 块级原生绘制、流式只重解析尾块）、标签条/输入区/空态/ 任务清单全面重绘、历史与记忆共用同一列表弹窗、MCP 确认改为对话区内联卡片、新增模型提问工具 ask_user（对话区内提问卡片，Enter 提交 / Esc 跳过），主题与深色模式对齐； 可用 -Dagent.ui.classic=true 一键回退到 3.0 的 HTML 渲染。

3.0.0

  • Memory candidates: preferences and corrections found in the chat wait in a review list until you confirm, edit or ignore them.
  • Full-text search over stored conversations (title and body) with a search box in the history popup; hits are highlighted.
  • Local usage statistics: one JSONL line per task in ~/.agent/logs/usage.jsonl, rotated at 10 MB; aggregated on demand, never uploaded.
  • Terminal tool (run_command) with a prefix allow-list, per-call confirmation and a hard deny list for destructive commands.
  • diagnostics and todo_write tools; the checklist is rendered above the transcript and stored with the conversation.
  • Context budget setting, retry/backoff for transport errors, log rotation.
  • English UI: buttons, status lines and settings labels follow the IDE language.

中文说明：记忆候选人工确认、历史会话全文检索、本地用量统计、终端工具与诊断工具、 任务清单、上下文预算、重试退避与日志轮转；界面按钮/状态行/设置页标签支持中英双语。
